headline: Crude Oil Prices Settle Lower to Mark Third Consecutive Weekly Loss
summary: Oil prices settled lower on Friday, recording a three-week losing streak as crude market supply conditions showed signs of improvement.
why: Crude oil is a crucial industrial commodity whose benchmark pricing influences global fuel costs, transport rates, and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Improving physical crude supplies weighed on global petroleum futures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Easing physical supply tightness and weak demand signals pushed crude benchmark contracts lower for a third straight week.
